Imperial Inspires Scholarships (Undergraduate)

Scholarship overview

  • Degree level

    Undergraduate

  • Value

    £15,000 for each year of the course.

  • Number of awards

    150

  • Academic year

    2027/2028

  • Tuition fee status

    Overseas

  • Mode of study

    Full time

  • Available to

    Prospective students

  • Application deadline

    05/02/2027

  • Additional information

    Scholarship page

    scholarships@imperial.ac.uk

  • Available to applicants in the following departments

    • Aeronautics
    • Bioengineering
    • Business School
    • Centre for Environmental Policy
    • Chemical Engineering
    • Chemistry
    • Civil and Environmental Engineering
    • Computing
    • Design Engineering
    • Earth Science and Engineering
    • Electrical and Electronic Engineering
    • Life Sciences
    • Materials
    • Mathematics
    • Mechanical Engineering
    • Physics
    • School of Medicine

Eligibility criteria

Imperial Inspires is our transformative new scholarships programme, designed to support talented students from the UK and around the globe to access an Imperial education. Scholarships are available to outstanding international applicants for undergraduate courses.

 

To be eligible, you must be:

  • An international student who is eligible to pay the Overseas rate of tuition.

  • Applying for a full-time undergraduate course within the Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Natural Sciences, Faculty of Medicine or Imperial College Business School.

Please note: This scholarship is available to new entrants only. Students already studying the course are not eligible.

Course specific information

All full-time, on-campus Undergraduate courses.

 

Application process

Step 1: Submit your Imperial application

Submit your Imperial undergraduate application through UCAS by 13 January 2027 (for MBBS, the UCAS application deadline is 15 October 2026.)

 

Step 2: Check your scholarship invitation

If an Imperial Inspires Scholarship is available for your course and you meet the minimum entry and eligibility requirements, you will be invited to apply for the scholarship. You will be asked to submit an optional 250-word statement explaining your motivation for studying at Imperial.

 

Step 3: Submit your scholarship application

Submit your Imperial Inspires Scholarship application by 23:59 (UK time) on 5 February 2027.

 

Step 4: Receive your outcome

You will be notified of the outcome of your scholarship application by email no later than 30 April 2027.

 

Please note that applications for the 2027 Inspires Scholarships will open in October (date to be confirmed). We are not currently accepting applications. 

Additional information

Futher details on how to play can be found on our Imperial Inspires webpages.

Contact

If you have any additional questions, please contact us at scholarships@imperial.ac.uk.
